_doc: s-meadhorn: Mead-Horn honey-bottle refill (dev.elsewhere.gear3.s3.meadhorn): action-bar messages and the refill JEI line (moved here from the generated files by s-asm-gear3 so a regen keeps them).

lang.item.elsewhere.hrafnholt_mead_horn.empty: The Mead-Horn is empty. Use it with a honey bottle in the other hand

elsewhere:hrafnholt_mead_horn: Drink: heal 6 over 3 s and gain 3 Fury stacks. The horn is then empty: use it with a honey bottle in the other hand (or use the bottle with the horn in the other hand) to refill it. The bottle is used up and you get a glass bottle back.
